entities.summary: Iñaq Uyu, also called Aklla Wasi, is an archaeological site in Bolivia situated on the Isla de la Luna, an island of Lake Titicaca. It is located in the La Paz Department, Manco Kapac Province, Copacabana Municipality. In Incan society, the societal structure was very rigid. Often those of belonging to the royal class structure did not mix with the lower classes.
